paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.98 as of the last update, with a 0.61 percent increase from the prior close and a 13.54 percent decrease over the last 22 sessions. The company has seen one new news headline in the last 24 hours.

The recent news is driven by the arrival of power generation equipment for Project Matador, which was announced by Fermi America on September 19, marking a major milestone for the project. This news was reported by KVII.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings, and 7 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a Form 8-K filing on August 31, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders, and multiple Form 4 filings, which reported insider transactions.
